title: News gate checked per-instrument only, not per shared-currency exposure -- tick179 attested USDJPY news_clear despite JOLTS/Consumer Confidence already found blocking for EURUSD 26min earlier same session
detail: tick176 (12:04Z, EURUSD) WebSearched today's calendar and correctly found JOLTS Job Openings + Conference Board Consumer Confidence (both 10:00 ET/14:00 UTC) inside the 2h blackout window, blocking the EURUSD entry. tick179 (12:30Z, USDJPY, ~26min later, same session) only checked FOMC (5.4h out, outside window) and attested news_clear for USDJPY without re-checking or carrying forward JOLTS/Consumer Confidence -- despite USDJPY being an equally USD-quoted pair directly exposed to the same US data release. tick179's USDJPY entry was blocked anyway on R:R (~0.71:1), so no bad trade resulted, but the news attestation itself was wrong for that tick. tick180 (13:00:49Z, USDJPY) re-ran WebSearch fresh and confirmed JOLTS/Consumer Confidence at 14:00 UTC, ~59min out, inside the window -- correctly blocked this tick on news.
impact: AUTO_TICK_PROTOCOL.md step5 instructs 'one WebSearch for high-impact events within 2h for the fired instrument(s)' -- read literally per-instrument, this misses that a single USD-side release (JOLTS, CPI, NFP, FOMC, GDP, PCE, ADP, PMI per CLAUDE.md's News Protocol list) blocks ALL USD-quoted pairs simultaneously, not just the one it was checked against. This tick, the gap was harmless because R:R also failed independently -- but it is a live risk: a future USDJPY (or USDCHF, or any other USD pair) signal with a clean trigger and clean R:R could slip through news-blocked if the tick's WebSearch is skipped or narrowly scoped after a same-session sibling tick already found the block.
classification: process - confirmed via cross-tick comparison (tick176 vs tick179), no financial harm this instance since R:R independently blocked, but the news attestation itself was incorrect for tick179
recommendation: Evan: update AUTO_TICK_PROTOCOL.md step5 to require checking the day's standing USD/EUR/GBP/JPY macro calendar once per session (not just re-deriving it per instrument), and to carry forward a same-day blocking finding across all correlated-currency instruments for the remainder of that finding's window, the same way FLAG-007/008 established a standing per-instrument finding that later ticks reference instead of re-deriving.
